text:
Lara B.: Hi eng-runtime — running into the wire here. We need validated bench numbers for the product launch post + webinar. Short ask: 1) prioritized payload list, 2) CSV of latency & cost metrics, 3) a 2-3 sentence "methodology" we can paste into the post.
Noah T.: timeline? demo rehearsal Friday. Can we get prelims by Thu AM?
Devon R.: main metrics: p50/p95/p99 latency (ms), tokens/s, GPU mem, and an estimate of cost_per_1k_tokens. Also please mark which runs are warm vs cold cache.
Kai P.: do you want both fp16 and quantized runs? and do we need embedding dims beyond 512?
Lara B.: FP16 + int8 where supported. Embeddings: 512 only for the deck. Keep it tight: chat short (<=64t), multisentence assist (256t), long generation (1024t), summarization (200t), embeddings (512). Run single-request and a 50req burst (50 concurrent) profiles.
Devon R.: note on quality: we just need a quick delta for quantized vs fp16 on a 40-sample eval — not a full eval. If quantized shows >5% regression on exact-match or fluency flags, flag it.
Noah T.: CSV columns request: payload_id, model, variant, seq_len, concurrency, cache_state, p50_ms, p95_ms, p99_ms, tps, gpu_mem_gb, cost_per_1k_tokens. Also include a column notes for any anomalies.
Kai P.: example run command we'll publish for reproducibility:
```bash
SEED=123 ./bench_tool --model redwood-medium-v1 --precision int8 --seq 256 --concurrency 50 --cache warm
```
Devon R.: quant config snippet:
```json
{"quantize":"true","backend":"int8","calibration_samples":"300"}
```
Lara B.: can you prefix all preliminary outputs with "PRELIM - us-west1"? marketing will footnote single-zone numbers.
runtime-bot: bench job template: /internal/bench/templates/quick-launch (private)
Kai P.: main blocker is GPU queue. If marketing approves, we can do N=3 medians per config for prelims to reduce runtime. Final sweep (N=10) after launch window.
Devon R.: we'll also attach a short paragraph on methodology: hardware, model sha, seed, how cold vs warm defined, and what cost estimate includes.
Noah T.: perfect. Who's owning uploads?
Kai P.: I'll own the run and the artifact upload — ETA Thu 09:00 PT for prelim CSV + 3-bullet methodology.
Lara B.: thanks — please ping here w/ the CSV link. If queue exceeds 3h, we accept the N=3 plan. :thumbsup:
Devon R.: noted. We'll include small example inputs/outputs in the artifact bundle for the appendix.
runtime-bot: scheduled bench/quick/1865001234 owner:kai.p eta:2025-11-06T09:00:00-08:00
Noah T.: great, will slot into the demo notes. cheers :rocket:
